title: Shared definitions of the gawk event contract
description: Definitions every data schema in this directory `$ref`s. Vocabularies (enums) only grow; treat an unknown value as unknown (docs/52 D6 b).

hexKey.description: A fleet HMAC'd handle: lower-case hex of even length, 8 to 64 characters. Stable for the lifetime of the relay's key, never reversible to the identifier it hides.

broadcastKey.description: The HMAC'd handle of a broadcast: what the portal, its links and its filters are keyed by.

roomKey.description: The HMAC'd handle of a room (docs/44 D16): what the portal, its links and its filters are keyed by.

broadcastId.description: A raw, joinable broadcast ID: six characters of the broadcast alphabet. Delivered on both channels — anyone who can read it can watch the broadcast.

roomCode.description: A raw, joinable room code: a dynamic room's six-character code or a static room's slug. Delivered on both channels — anyone who can read it can join the room.

displayCode.description: The code as shown to participants. Joinable, so treated exactly like roomCode.

roomKind.description: Whether the room is an operator-created static room or a participant-created dynamic one.

clientKind.description: What kind of client a participant is (the wire protocol's RoomHello clientKind).

broadcastRole.description: Which side of the relay cascade the publishing pod plays for the broadcast.

enforcement.description: Present, as `pending`, when the Kubernetes object that would make this moderation event true had not been written when it was recorded; absent when record and enforcement agree. A reconciler completes the enforcement within about a minute.

actor.description: Who did it: an operator's identity as the identity provider names it, or `system`.

reason.description: Free text. For a moderation event, the operator's reason; for a lifecycle event, a closed word the type's schema enumerates.

nickname.description: A participant's chosen display name: free user text.

label.description: A room tile's label: free user text.

participantId.description: The room-scoped participant id the roster uses. Not a join capability.

summary.description: One human sentence describing the event, so a receiver that renders nothing else still shows something meaningful. Added by gawk-admin on webhook delivery; never set by the relay.

portalUrl.description: A deep link into the gawk-admin portal, filtered by the HMAC'd key. It carries no capability: acting requires logging in. Added by gawk-admin on webhook delivery; never set by the relay.
